<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/components/shell-parts.ts -->
<!--
  The sidebar of DashboardShell. Shapes: wide (icon and name), rail (icons only, the names still read),
  collapsed (the static collapsed state of a wide sidebar, with its expand button), twolevel (a rail beside a
  panel of the current section's links). side puts it at the start or the end.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { ShellNav } from "../blocks/dashboard-shell.types";

export type ShellSidebarProps = {
  nav: ShellNav;
  mode?: "wide" | "rail" | "collapsed" | "twolevel" | "none";
  side?: "start" | "end";
  brand?: "show" | "hide";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import ButtonPlain from "../primitives/button-plain/button-plain.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.vue";
import Link from "../primitives/link/link.vue";
import List from "../primitives/list/list.vue";
import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const { nav, mode = "wide", side = "start", brand = "show" } = defineProps<ShellSidebarProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ toggle: [] }>();
const named = computed(() => (mode as string) === "wide");
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="aside"
    :class="cn(
      'flex shrink-0 bg-card',
      (
        (side as string) === 'end' ? 'flex-row-reverse border-l border-border'
        : 'border-r border-border'
      )
    )"
    :aria-label="nav.label"
    data-testid="sidebar"
    :data-mode="mode"
  >
    <Box :class="cn('flex flex-col gap-6 py-4', (named ? 'w-64 px-4' : 'w-16 items-center px-2'))">
      <Group v-if="((brand as string) === 'show')" gap="2" align="center" class="shrink-0" data-testid="brand">
        <LucideIcon name="layers" :size="24" />
        <Text size="base" weight="bold" :class="(named ? '' : 'sr-only')">
          {{ nav.brand }}
        </Text>
      </Group>
      <Block tag="nav" class="flex-1" :aria-label="nav.label">
        <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0" data-testid="items">
          <ListItem v-for="l in nav.links" :key="l.id">
            <Link
              href="#/"
              variant="default"
              size="sm"
              :aria-current="((l.id === nav.current) ? 'page' : undefined)"
              :class="cn(
                'flex items-center gap-4 rounded py-2',
                (named ? 'px-4' : 'justify-center px-2'),
                ((l.id === nav.current) ? 'bg-muted font-medium' : '')
              )"
              data-testid="item"
            >
              <LucideIcon :name="l.icon" :size="16" />
              <Inline :class="(named ? '' : 'sr-only')">
                {{ l.name }}
              </Inline>
            </Link>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
      </Block>
      <ButtonPlain v-if="((mode as string) === 'collapsed')"
        type="button"
        class="inline-flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded text-muted-foreground"
        :aria-label="nav.expand"
        :aria-expanded="(((mode as string) === 'wide') ? 'true' : 'false')"
        data-testid="toggle"
        @click="() => emit('toggle')"
      >
        <LucideIcon name="panel-left" :size="20" />
      </ButtonPlain>
    </Box>
    <Box v-if="((mode as string) === 'twolevel')"
      :class="cn(
        'flex w-56 flex-col gap-4 px-4 py-6',
        (((side as string) === 'end') ? 'border-r border-border' : 'border-l border-border')
      )"
      data-testid="subnav"
    >
      <Text size="sm" weight="semibold" class="px-4">
        {{ nav.subTitle }}
      </Text>
      <Block tag="nav" :aria-label="nav.subTitle">
        <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0">
          <ListItem v-for="s in nav.sub" :key="s.id">
            <Link
              href="#/"
              variant="default"
              size="sm"
              :aria-current="((s.id === nav.subCurrent) ? 'page' : undefined)"
              :class="cn(
                'flex items-center gap-4 rounded py-2',
                (true ? 'px-4' : 'justify-center px-2'),
                ((s.id === nav.subCurrent) ? 'bg-muted font-medium' : '')
              )"
              data-testid="item"
            >
              <LucideIcon :name="s.icon" :size="16" />
              <Inline :class="(true ? '' : 'sr-only')">
                {{ s.name }}
              </Inline>
            </Link>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
      </Block>
    </Box>
  </Block>
</template>
